t: ff.126 Google: the end or a rebirth?
st: Why reinventing yourself matters, even when all is going well

sec.t: ff.126.1 From extermination camps to Intel
sec.p: Andy Grove survived the Holocaust. Then, having emigrated to America from Hungary, he led Intel right from its birth (co-founded with Moore, the one with the law).

sec.t: ff.126.2 It's not the end of Google
sec.p: Exterminated by ChatGPT and Perplexity? Google today is in a similar situation. 50% of its business, Google Search ($200 billion a year), is under attack. On top of that, Apple is thinking of replacing it as the default on Safari (even though Google pays $20 billion for that…
Here are Google's advantages over OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Perplexity, according to its CEO Sundar Pichai:
The final gem. After AlphaGo and AlphaStar, Google/DeepMind recently unveiled AlphaEvolve. Not to win at video games, but to revolutionise mathematics.
